verdict.rationale: Riveter's own docs include a legacy-to-current endpoint migration mapping (e.g. /run_new_enrichment → /enrich), which shows it manages API evolution and retires old endpoints. It is only a thin signal: there is no explicit versioning scheme or formal deprecation policy. Missing for 10: an explicit API versioning scheme (version in path or header), a documented deprecation policy with timelines or sunset notices, a changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
